fixed_validation_partition: 1980 images from official CIFAR-100 TRAIN; 20/class for IDs 1..99; class 0 absent

interpretation.C1_minus_C2: Primary estimate of the added contribution of CC-SAM-style class-conditional feature-gradient perturbation, with class weights, alpha schedule, sampler, initialization, and optimizer held fixed.
interpretation.C2_minus_C0: Contribution of the CC-SAM Stage-II class weighting and alpha blend without feature perturbation, relative to balanced CE.
interpretation.C1_minus_C0: Overall effect of transferring the CC-SAM Stage-II objective and feature perturbation together.
limitations: All Stage-II seeds share one Clean Stage-I backbone and one fixed TRAIN-derived validation partition.
The validation partition has no class-0 examples and has been used in prior development; it is not an independent test set.
Three Stage-II seeds quantify optimization/sampling variability conditional on this fixed representation, not representation-level or cross-dataset generalization.
This is a controlled transfer of CC-SAM Stage II, not a full reproduction of the original two-stage CC-SAM training pipeline.
